reviewer: independent Critic, fresh Claude Opus context, 2026-10-30

findings.text: The loop restart at 172.0 s drops into the track's quiet intro: from 172.5 to 173.56 s the music falls to -45 to -62 dB (1 s average -41.7 against a -33 bed), mostly while the voice is silent, then snaps back to -28 dB within 20 ms, recreating the owner's 'turns off then gets louder' complaint.
The opening bed sits at -41 to -49 dB for 0 to 2.56 s, then jumps +15 to +18 dB within 20 ms under the first sentence; start the music past the track's quiet intro or fade it in.
After the voice ends at 320.34 s the music jumps about 13 to 16 dB above the bed at 321.08 s for about 2.3 s, then fades in about 0.3 s, which contradicts the one-steady-level brief.

A stray 0.25 s voiced blip (-18 dB RMS, peak -9.5 dBFS) at 243.58 to 243.83 s sits alone in the pause between 'Every single time.' and 'Then a board briefing'; it is in neither the script nor words.json and was also in the rejected mix.

After the 74.1 s and 245.1 s crossfades the bed changes texture (bass -6 dB, nothing above 5 kHz, weaker beat) with 0.3 to 0.4 s dips at 74.8 and 245.7 s; the level holds on a 1 s scale but the change is audible as a new section.
The music bed is one 171 s arrangement played twice, so the second half repeats the first verbatim.
words.json onsets after pauses run 0.3 to 0.5 s ahead of the voice (1.1 s for 'Then' at 244.21 against 245.32 spoken), so some captions appear before the word is heard.
The caption reads 'That's pretty Awkward.' with a capital A mid-sentence (picture unchanged from the accepted version).
The card claims '3/3 runs where DeepSeek deleted its Xinjiang answer' while the voice says each model was asked twice and the chart shows DeepSeek 1/2.
The call card stacks a 'THE CALL' label over the headline 'OUR CALL.', and its 90%-sure prediction is never spoken in the voiceover.

The music no longer follows the voice (speech -33.22 dB against pauses -33.31 dB, correlation 0.04, against 0.75 in the rejected mix), 20 s pause blocks hold -32.5 to -35.5 dB (rejected: -24.2 to -33.7), and the master measures -14.2 LUFS integrated, -1.4 dBTP, LRA 4.2 LU.
